content: This document provides a summary of information about the product but does not include all possible details. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. This information is not intended to replace personalized medical advice and should not be used as a substitute for consultation with your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and to address your individual health needs. The information was last updated in September 2024. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same category. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary details are subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. If you choose to send this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
